bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck, for up to seven guests. Lunch is one seating from 12.30pm (last seating 1pm) and dinner from 7pm (last seating 7.30pm).
cancellation: Cancellations by phone only, more than 72 hours ahead. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged S$580 a person.
dressCode: No heavy perfume: guests whose scent is overpowering may be turned away.
byob: No outside bottles; the restaurant does not allow corkage.
